title: Chief administrative officer recruitment update
subtitle: Closed-session recruitment discussion, staff direction on final negotiations, and an announcement expected in the near future.
overview: Council held a special meeting on August 22, 2024 to consider the recruitment of a new Chief Administrative Officer (CAO). The previous CAO retired in June 2024. Council moved into a closed session to discuss the recruitment and an appointment, citing personal matters about an identifiable individual and labour relations or employee negotiations.

After returning to open session, the Mayor reported that Council had received recommendations from the CAO recruitment, selection and performance subcommittee. Council gave staff direction. Council then received the report titled Chief Administrative Officer Recruitment Update {{vote:m2}}.

The Mayor said staff and the executive search firm hired by the city have been directed to begin final negotiations with the recommended candidate. This was reported as staff direction and not as a separate motion. An announcement is expected in the near future once those negotiations finish. The CAO leads city staff, so the appointment matters to residents.

decisions.detail: Council received the Chief Administrative Officer Recruitment Update report dated August 22, 2024 {{vote:m2}}.

debate: No debate took place in open session; the Mayor asked if anyone wished to speak on receiving the report, and no one did.

The substantive discussion happened in closed session. Publicly, the Mayor said only that Council received the subcommittee's search and recruitment information and a recommended candidate, and gave staff direction.
The Mayor noted that final negotiations with the recommended candidate come first, and that an announcement will follow once they are complete.
